citation: Potočnik et al. 2023. Locomotor–Respiratory Entrainment upon Phonated Compared to Spontaneous Breathing during Submaximal Exercise. International Journal of Environmental Research and Public Health
protocol: Moderate steady cycling with spontaneous, phonated-exhalation and phonated-inhalation breathing patterns; breath-by-breath values
note: Results reported as mean +/- SD (stated in the methods). Moderate intensity is not given as %VO2max or watts in the text read, and the table has a mixed-looking SD column (one value is much larger); check the table before use.
